tldr: Venus through the 7th house brings focus to partnerships, clients, contracts, and direct others.
body: Venus transiting the 7th house softens partnerships, clients, contracts, and direct others. For about three to four weeks, ease, attraction, value, pleasure, and relational support move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a receiving transit: it can bring support, pleasure, repair, and opportunities to value this area with more grace.
business: Venus supports relationship dynamics and agreements: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Avoidance, indulgence, people-pleasing, or handing your agency to someone else.
advice: Receive and refine in the 7th house deliberately. Work with partnerships, clients, contracts, and direct others without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
